description: Guided breathing exercises (4-7-8, box, energize) with an animated pacer circle, phase labels, and cycle counter.

faqs.a: Inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s. It is a popular calming pattern said to slow the heart rate and ease stress.
Equal 4-second phases: inhale, hold, exhale, hold. Used by athletes and first responders to steady focus.
Sit comfortably, breathe through your nose, and stop if you feel dizzy. These are relaxation aids, not medical treatment.
Choose a pattern, set your cycles, press Start, and follow the expanding/contracting circle and phase labels.
faqs.q: How do I use the pacer?

howto: Set how many cycles you want.
Press Start and follow the animated circle.
Match each phase: inhale, hold, exhale.
title: Breathing Exercise Guide
